rules.statement: An intervenient may present evidence of title to an unallotted share following the entry of an interlocutory decree.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) A practice has developed whereby even an intervenient is permitted to prove his title to an unallotted share after the interlocutory decree is entered. (2) The right of a party to prove his title to a share left unallotted in the final decree is recognised

rules.statement: A party has the right to present evidence of their entitlement to an undistributed share as determined by a final decree.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) A practice has developed whereby even an intervenient is permitted to prove his title to an unallotted share after the interlocutory decree is entered. (2) The right of a party to prove his title to a share left unallotted in the final decree is recognised

meta.parties: Sapin Singho v. Luwis Singho and Others
